stemMd: Vectors $u=(2,-3)$ and $v=(-1,4)$ are given. What is $2u+v$?
explanationMd: Double each coordinate of u to get (4,−6), then add v coordinate by coordinate. The result is (4−1,−6+4)=(3,−2).

distractorRationale.c: This subtracts v after doubling u.
distractorRationale.b: This adds u and v without doubling u.
distractorRationale.d: This doubles both vectors rather than only u.
